name: Chopped Paste
author: Fannie Merritt Farmer (1896)
steps: Mix salt with flour, put in chopping tray, add lard and butter, and chop until well mixed.
Moisten to a dough with cold water.
Toss on floured cloth (Magic Cover), pat, and roll out.
Fold so as to make three layers, turn half-way round, pat, and roll out; repeat.
Should the butter be too hard, it will not mix readily with the flour, in which case the result will be a tough crust.
Omit lard, and use all butter, if preferred.

culture.text: From The Boston Cooking-School Cook Book (1896) by Fannie Merritt Farmer. It popularized level, standardized measurements (cups and spoons) in American home kitchens, and stayed one of the best-selling cookbooks in the United States for decades.
